weakness: No account procedure, approvals, or reviews; shared field crew login; former bookkeeper mailbox active 6 months; stale dealer accounts in the telematics portal
remediation_plan: Onboarding, season-end, and departure checklists; monthly reconciliation; named SYS-01 crew accounts with tablet PINs; remove stale telematics accounts
milestones: 2026-07-21 bookkeeper mailbox disabled; 2026-08-14 stale telematics accounts removed; 2026-09-30 checklists in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation; 2026-11-30 shared field login retired

weakness: Dealer remote access to the pump station is always on, unauthorized, and undocumented; no documented rules for MSP or telematics remote access
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P03 G-071; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Gateway enabled only for approved sessions; named dealer accounts with MFA through the gateway maker's remote access service; remote access rules in POL-02 B.8; security terms in the dealer agreement
milestones: 2026-09-30 dealer agreement amended; 2026-10-31 on-request access in place and tested

weakness: Backups not immutable, 30 days only, one password-only admin; SYS-01 never exported; controller program and documents held only by the dealer
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P03 G-064; P04 finding 2; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: 90-day immutable versions with MFA on the console; monthly SYS-01 export to an encrypted drive; farm-held controller program copy after every change; scan the dealer's wiring and program documents
milestones: 2026-09-30 controller program copy received; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded; 2026-10-31 first monthly export; 2026-11-30 documents scanned
resources_required: About $500 a year; dealer time (included in POAM-002)

weakness: No contingency plan, restore test, exercise, or hand-operation drill
remediation_plan: First SYS-08 restore test and quarterly tests after; tabletop with the MSP and dealer using the P08 runbook; contingency plan with the hand-operation procedure; Field Supervisor trained and drilled before the season
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2027-01-31 contingency plan; 2027-02-28 hand-operation drill
resources_required: MSP labor (about 2 hours a quarter); staff time

weakness: Antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours and no farm staff; no behavior-based detection; no false-positive process
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on the 3 office computers; alerts by text to the Security Coordinator and the Owner and General Manager
milestones: 2026-10-31 contract signed; 2026-12-31 deployed and alert test passed

weakness: Flat network reaches the pump station from the shop Wi-Fi; gateway is a second unmanaged path; firewall logs kept 7 days and not reviewed
source: P07 test; P03 G-071; P04 finding 1; P01 R-020, R-023
remediation_plan: Separate firewall segment for the pump station; guest Wi-Fi for visitors and dealers; gateway on request only (POAM-002); firewall log retention extended to 90 days
milestones: 2026-10-31 guest Wi-Fi and new staff Wi-Fi password; 2026-12-31 pump station segment in place and retested

weakness: Gateway accepted the default password from the internet (new finding); touchscreen default PIN on a label; Wi-Fi and field login unchanged for years; no lost-device procedure
source: P07 (new finding IA-05e.); P03 G-053; P01 R-023, R-020
remediation_plan: Dealer changed the gateway password and turned off internet-facing administration; change the touchscreen PIN and remove the label; new Wi-Fi password; password rules and a lost-device procedure (POL-02 B.9)
milestones: 2026-08-14 gateway password changed and administration closed; 2026-09-30 firmware update and retest; 2026-10-31 PIN and Wi-Fi changed

weakness: No MFA on the Technician's SYS-01 administrator account, the backup console, or the gateway login

milestones: 2026-09-15 SYS-01 MFA enforced; 2026-09-30 backup console MFA evidence received

weakness: Dealer remote maintenance not approved, monitored, recorded, or ended
source: P07 (MA-04 objectives); P03 G-078; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Technician approves each session, watches it where possible, and records the date, technician, and work done in the change log; gateway disabled at session end

weakness: No security or privacy terms for the irrigation dealer, equipment dealer, or AI vendor; no MSP incident notice term; no ongoing oversight

resources_required: Owner time; outside counsel review (about $600, within the policy work budget)

weakness: Gateway and controller firmware never updated; no firmware testing; no time limits for updates; tablets and phones not managed

weakness: Staff not told how, when, or to whom to report incidents
source: P07 interviews; P03 G-087; P01 R-016
